gatoh.logging.logging.GATOHLogger

class GATOHLogger(model: Any, max_iterations: int, hierarchies: list[str], verbose: bool = False, print_interval: int = 10, print_outside_interval: bool = True, write_file: bool = True)[source]

The logging module will contain all functions related to logging and/or printing model progress and information both during and after simulation.

Parameters:

  • model (ABModel) – The parent model that the logger is being attached to.

  • max_iterations (int) – The maximum number of iterations that the parent model is running its simulation for.

  • hierarchies (list[str]) – The names of the social hierarchies present in the parent model.

  • verbose (bool, optional) – A flag indicating if extended information should be printed during logging.

  • print_interval (int, optional) – The number of model iterations to run in between each printed logging output.

  • print_outside_interval (bool, optional) – A flag indicating if a simple string indicating just the iteration number should be printed outside the print_interval.

  • write_file (bool, optional) – A flag indicating if a log file should be written to disk at the end of logging.
